accounts_opening.name: accounts_opening
accounts_opening.value: ("accounts"."kind" = 'tracking' AND "accounts"."opening_cents" IS NULL AND "accounts"."opening_date" IS NULL) OR ("accounts"."kind" IN ('cash', 'credit') AND "accounts"."opening_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."opening_date" IS NOT NULL)

accounts_cents.name: accounts_cents
accounts_cents.value: "accounts"."opening_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("accounts"."opening_cents") = 'integer' AND "accounts"."opening_cents" BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991)

setup_state.name: setup_state
setup_state.value: ("setup"."state" = 'open' AND "setup"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "setup"."import_id" IS NULL) OR ("setup"."state" = 'fresh' AND "setup"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "setup"."import_id" IS NULL) OR ("setup"."state" = 'ynab' AND "setup"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "setup"."import_id" IS NOT NULL)

import_sources_bytes.name: import_sources_bytes
import_sources_bytes.value: typeof("import_sources"."byte_length") = 'integer' AND "import_sources"."byte_length" BETWEEN 0 AND 67108864 AND length("import_sources"."bytes") = "import_sources"."byte_length"

import_register_posting.name: import_register_posting
import_register_posting.value: ("import_register_rows"."treatment" = 'posted' AND "import_register_rows"."posted_on" IS NOT NULL) OR ("import_register_rows"."treatment" <> 'posted' AND "import_register_rows"."posted_on" IS NULL)

import_observations_current.name: import_observations_current
import_observations_current.value: "import_observations"."current_adjustment_cents" IS NULL OR (typeof("import_observations"."current_adjustment_cents") = 'integer' AND "import_observations"."current_adjustment_cents" BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991)

budget_month.name: budget_month
budget_month.value: length("budget_state"."start_month") = 7 AND "budget_state"."start_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr("budget_state"."start_month",6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'

budget_assignment_month.name: budget_assignment_month
budget_assignment_month.value: length("budget_assignments"."month") = 7 AND "budget_assignments"."month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND substr("budget_assignments"."month",6,2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12'

budget_source_owner.name: budget_source_owner
budget_source_owner.value: ("budget_source_memberships"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "budget_source_memberships"."transfer_id" IS NULL) OR ("budget_source_memberships"."event_id" IS NULL AND "budget_source_memberships"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL)
